pokedexEntries.bk: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

pokedexEntries.wh: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
